bee.v1.DeploymentRequiredContexts.description:
Required status contexts for a deployment, wrapped so "unset" (all required contexts)
differs from an empty list (skip the check).
bee.v1.DeploymentRequiredContexts.title: bee.v1.DeploymentRequiredContexts

bee.v1.ObjectId.description: 34-byte object id: algorithm byte, kind byte, 32-byte digest (SPEC §3.1).
bee.v1.ObjectId.title: bee.v1.ObjectId

bee.v1.RepoRef.description:
Every repo-scoped request names its repo by id or by "org/name".

Oneof `repo`: at most one of `id`, `fullName` is set.
bee.v1.RepoRef.title: bee.v1.RepoRef

autoMerge.description: first merge the default ref into `ref` if it is behind

changeset.description: optional pin; must be the ref's tip or reachable from it

deployGreenTip.description:
When the environment requires green and `ref`'s tip is not green, deploy the newest green
changeset of `ref` (what `green/<ref>` marks) instead of refusing. Ignored with `changeset`.
